resources.string: Optional, off by default. Request a more visible system notification for a running timer, with its existing elapsed-time counter and controls. Android decides whether to promote it and may demote it. No proprietary island integration or manufacturer certification is promised.
Available only on supported Android 16 system builds. On Android 12–15, the ordinary notification, widget and tile remain available.
Request Live Updates for the running timer
This Android 16 build does not expose the newer promotion-request API. It may keep an ordinary notification; a supported system update is needed for the newer presentation.
Android allows promotion requests. Notification permission, channel settings and system or manufacturer criteria still apply; a chip is not guaranteed.
Android currently blocks promoted notifications for this app. The ordinary timer controls remain available when notifications are allowed.
Android promotion eligibility could not be read. This is not a guarantee of Live Update availability.
The current notification has promotable characteristics. This does not prove that Android will promote it.
The current notification does not meet Android’s promotion characteristics. It stays an ordinary notification.

This choice stays on this device and is not included in backups. Dismissing a timer notification suppresses further promotion requests for that entry, including after pause and resume. A new entry is eligible again. To explicitly reset dismissal, turn this option off and on. No battery-life improvement is claimed.
Choice saved. Android controls the final presentation.
The choice could not be saved. Try again; the normal timer is unchanged.
Choice saved, but the notification could not be refreshed. Reopen the app or try again. Do not stop or recreate the timer just to refresh its appearance.
